example_sentences_in_bangla: আমার পকেট খালি, আজ কোনো টাকা নেই।
সে বলল, তার পকেট শূন্য হয়ে গেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: My pockets are empty; I have no money today.
He said his pockets are barren; he's completely broke.
note: These variants all metaphorically describe financial emptiness using imagery of barrenness or void in Bengali colloquial speech.
